descriptionByLocale.en:
"Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer exciting challenges and ample opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner to the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality and sustainability, while fostering a culture that empowers you to thrive. Join a rapidly expanding global company, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact.

Your Role:
At Siegfried we are currently looking for a Legal Counsel to join our legal team in our site based in Zofingen.

Reporting to the Global Head Integrity, Risk & Insurance your key responsibilities will be:

- Provide legal advice and support on integrity and corporate governance, as well as on commercial and contract law matters, partnering closely with business leaders, corporate functions, and management teams.

- Assist in the development and maintenance of global data protection, privacy and information security frameworks and related governance processes, providing pragmatic and business-oriented legal support.

- Contribute to integrity, insurance & risk management initiatives, supporting the development and continuous improvement of related frameworks, policies and processes.

- Provide day-to-day legal support across a broad range of business activities, including procurement, sales, operations and corporate functions.

- Draft, review and negotiate a wide variety of commercial agreements, including manufacturing and supply agreements, procurement contracts, service agreements, confidentiality agreements and other business contracts.

- Support dispute management and assist in the handling and resolution of out-of-court and in-court disputes.

Purpose of the Role:

Support Siegfried's business by providing practical, solution-oriented legal advice across a broad range of legal matters. This legal generalist role offers broad exposure to commercial, corporate, integrity and governance matters, providing an excellent opportunity for a motivated legal professional to develop diverse expertise and grow into a trusted business partner within an international environment.
Your Profile:

What are we looking for?

We are seeking a motivated and ambitious legal professional who enjoys working across a broad range of legal topics. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow within an international organization. You combine solid legal fundamentals with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and are comfortable taking ownership of tasks and projects early in your career.

Requirements:

• Master’s degree in Law (Swiss MLaw or equivalent international qualification) preferred. A Bachelor’s degree in Law, combined with relevant professional experience will also be considered. Admission to the bar is an advantage but not required.

• 2–5 years of relevant professional experience gained in a law firm, consulting environment or in-house legal department. Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences or CDMO industry is considered an advantage.

• Exposure to commercial, corporate or contract law. Additional experience or interest in data protection, information security, compliance, risk management or related areas is considered a plus .

Skills & Competencies:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate legal concepts into practical, business-oriented advice.

• Excellent drafting and communication skills. Professional proficiency in English and German (written and spoken) is required. Additional language skills, particularly French or Spanish, are considered a plus.

• High level of integrity, sound judgment and professional ethics.

• Curiosity and willingness to learn across a broad range of legal and governance topics.

• Self-driven, proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.

• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills in a cross-functional, international environment

Your Benefits:

​ What do we offer?

• Pension Plan: Our company-sponsored pension plan is attractive and offers flexible contribution options

• Our stock purchase plan is generous and can be tailored to individual needs

• Child Allowance: Siegfried AG increases the child allowance by 10% above the cantonal statutory rate

• Reka-Geld: Siegfried AG offers employees a 20% discount

• Staff restaurant / cafeteria: Meals at preferential rates

• You can park at a discounted rate

• Centrally located: Close to the train station with excellent public transportation connections

Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network of 16 sites across three continents. With a team of more than 4,200 highly skilled professionals, we take the innovations of our pharmaceutical customers to industrial scale and manufacture safe drugs for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today that can carry out the development and manufacturing of APIs and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of know-how and experience makes us the most trusted partner in the pharmaceutical industry.

Siegfried is a leading CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) headquartered in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates manufacturing sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).

descriptionByLocale.en:
"Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer exciting challenges and ample opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner to the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality and sustainability, while fostering a culture that empowers you to thrive. Join a rapidly expanding global company, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact.

Your Role:
The Global Head of Sales and Business Development for Drug Products is responsible for leading the global sales strategy, execution, and revenue growth of the organization’s drug product portfolio. This role will focus on commercializing drug product manufacturing and services while further developing the global sales team and strengthening business development activities.

Strategic Leadership
-Define and execute the global sales strategy for the drug product business unit, aligning with company goals and growth objectives
-Identify and evaluate new market opportunities, emerging trends, and customer needs in the drug product space (clinical through commercial)
-Partner with executive leadership to shape long-term business development initiatives

Sales & Business Development
- Drive global revenue generation across drug product services, including formulation, fill-finish, and packaging
- Build, maintain, and expand relationships with key clients (pharma, biotech, generics)
- Negotiate and close complex, high-value deals and long-term contracts

Team Leadership & Management
- Lead, develop, and mentor a global sales team across multiple regions (North America, Europe)
- Establish clear performance targets and ensure accountability through KPIs, forecasting, and pipeline management
- Foster a high-performance, customer-centric sales culture

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with marketing, R&D, operations, and project management to ensure seamless client engagement
- Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to guide product development and service innovation
-Collaborate with supply chain and operations to ensure capacity and capabilities meet customer demand

Financial Management:
-Own global revenue targets and sales budget for the drug product business
- Monitor pricing strategies, margin performance, and profitability
- Report regularly to executive leadership on pipeline, performance, and forecast
Your Profile:
Technically, you bring:
- a proven track record in selling drug product development & manufacturing services (e.g., formulation, OSD, sterile fill-finish, aseptic processing, packaging)
- significant commercial leadership in the pharmaceutical/biopharma CDMO sector, including managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios
- expertise in designing and implementing commercial strategies (including customer segmentation, technology priority, and geographic focus). You are both shaping the plan and driving its execution.
- experience across several drug product technologies (oral solids, sterile injectables, fill-finish, ophthalmics, spray drying)
- active relationships with External Manufacturing or Strategic Sourcing functions. and exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills
- having experience with integrating or connecting drug substance + drug product portfolio commercial strategy would be an added value

You have strong Leadership competencies, in particular, you have demonstrated your ability to:
- Empower people
- Drive business growth and Excel operationally as a network
- Make decisions
- Act reliably and accountably
- Foster innovation and excellence
- Foster customer intimacy, Deliver quality and value

You have an advanced degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, or Business; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Your Benefits:
At Siegfried, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll discover a place where your impact matters, your growth is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported.

Professional Growth & Impact
- You'll find a dynamic, international environment with room to take ownership and make a long term sustainable impact.
- You'll be able to build and shape the function
- Through your impact and Individual development solutions you'll grow personally and professionally at a fast pace.
- You'll collaborate with an experienced, passionate teams that values excellence, quality and continuous learning.

Attractive Compensation & Incentives
- Short-term incentive programs recognizing both performance and contribution
- Long-term incentive plan focused on sustained value creation

Flexibility & Wellbeing
- Flexible working hours and hybrid work options.
- Comprehensive accident and health insurance coverage.
- Active health management and discounted fitness memberships.

Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network of 16 sites across three continents. With a team of more than 4,200 highly skilled professionals, we take the innovations of our pharmaceutical customers to industrial scale and manufacture safe drugs for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today that can carry out the development and manufacturing of APIs and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of know-how and experience makes us the most trusted partner in the pharmaceutical industry.

Siegfried is a leading CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) headquartered in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates manufacturing sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).

descriptionByLocale.en:
"Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer exciting challenges and ample opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner to the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality and sustainability, while fostering a culture that empowers you to thrive. Join a rapidly expanding global company, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact. Your Role: In this newly created role, you will lead the global Drug Product (DP) Development organization and further strengthen Siegfried’s pharmaceutical development capabilities. You will drive the advancement of Siegfried’s DP technologies and development project performance across all clinical phases. You will ensure best-in-class pharmaceutical R&D processes covering multiple dosage forms, including oral solid dosage forms, parenterals, inhalables, and ophthalmics. The role includes evaluating new customer development requests for formulation and process development, overseeing execution of development programs, and ensuring successful transfer to GMP manufacturing. In addition, you will build and expand the organization’s capabilities by attracting, developing, and mentoring top DP development talent across sites. Your Profile: In that role, you will
• Lead and manage the global Drug Product Development & Technologies function , with oversight of pharmaceutical development, characterization capabilities, and development project execution from preclinical development through Phase III and commercialization .
• Lead the inquiry-to-offer process for new client development requests, ensuring high-quality, scientifically robust and competitive development proposals through strong technological evaluation and efficient decision making.
• Oversee the multi-site execution of Siegfried’s global development project portfolio , ensuring scientific excellence, timely execution, and strong customer outcomes.
• Monitor scientific and technology trends to identify emerging formulation technologies, services, and development opportunities.
• Strengthen Siegfried’s reputation as a leading Drug Product Development partner for pharmaceutical and biotech clients.
• Develop and maintain global DP technology roadmaps across development phases, sites, and dosage forms.
• Collaborate closely with key internal stakeholders including Business Development & Sales, manufacturing sites, and other global functions .
• Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing global team , attracting and nurturing top scientific talent. Technical profile
• Pharmacist or equivalent scientific background; PhD in Pharmaceutical Technology preferred
• Deep expertise in oral solid dosage form (OSD) and parenteral development is essential , including experience with complex formulations (e.g., BCS Class II/III compounds, amorphous solid dispersions)
• Proven track record of advancing OSD and/or parenteral programs from early development through clinical phases to commercialization
• Strong understanding of analytical characterization and CMC development for OSD and parenteral dosage forms
• Working knowledge and/or strategic oversight of additional dosage forms (e.g., inhalation, ophthalmic) is advantageous
• Deep expertise in CMC development , preferably within Drug Product Development
• With demonstrated track record advancing development programs from early research through clinical development and product launch
• Experience contributing to or generating Drug Product intellectual property
• Strong academic network and experience with public-private collaborations Leadership profile:
• Proven ability to build and lead global teams across multiple sites
• Strong cross-cultural leadership and global mindset
• Experience working effectively in complex matrix organizations
• Ability to influence stakeholders in multi-site environments with indirect reporting structures Your Benefits: At Siegfried, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll discover a place where your impact matters, your growth is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported. Professional Growth & Impact - You'll find a dynamic, international environment with room to take ownership and make a long term sustainable impact. - You'll be able to build and shape the function - Through your impact and Individual development solutions you'll grow personally and professionally at a fast pace. - You'll collaborate with an experienced, passionate teams that values excellence, quality and continuous learning. Attractive Compensation & Incentives - Short-term incentive programs recognizing both performance and contribution - Long-term incentive plan focused on sustained value creation Flexibility & Wellbeing - Flexible working hours and hybrid work options. - Comprehensive accident and health insurance coverage. - Active health management and discounted fitness memberships. Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network of 13 sites across three continents. With a team of more than 3,800 highly skilled professionals, we take the innovations of our pharmaceutical customers to industrial scale and manufacture safe drugs for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today that can carry out the development and manufacturing of APIs and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of know-how and experience makes us the most trusted partner in the pharmaceutical industry. Siegfried is a leading CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) headquartered in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates manufacturing sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).

• Profile Professional Skills - Completed vocational training as an electrician / mechatronics technician (EFZ) or equivalent technical qualification - Professional experience as a maintenance electrician is an advantage - Maintenance electrician license according to NIV13 or willingness to obtain it - Good knowledge of PLC programming (Siemens S7, S5) - Knowledge in the field of control engineering - Good German language skills, both written and spoken Personal Strengths - Enjoyment of varied and independent work - High reliability and sense of responsibility - Structured and solution-oriented approach - Teamwork skills and confident demeanor in daily work - Willingness to perform on-call duties ## Your Benefits - Flexible working hours to balance family, leisure, and work - Discounted parking available - Health insurance: discounts of up to 10% on supplementary insurance with our partners - Generous and customizable share purchase plan - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the child allowance by 10% above the cantonal legal minimum and additionally pays CHF 100 per month - Individual training opportunities - Reka money: Siegfried AG grants employees a 20% discount - Attractive company pension fund - Staff restaurant / cafeteria: meals at preferential rates - Central location: close to the train station with excellent public transport connections Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network with 13 sites across three continents. Responsabilités au niveau du site : 1. leadership RH du site et partenariat commercial - Définir et exécuter la feuille de route RH du site, alignée sur la stratégie RH mondiale et les priorités opérationnelles. - Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès de l'équipe dirigeante du site, en stimulant les performances, l'efficacité du leadership et la santé de l'organisation. - Mener des initiatives en matière de changement, de transformation et de culture, en soutenant l'évolution du site et la continuité des activités. - Assurer la continuité des activités des RH, la préparation aux crises et l'atténuation des risques liés à la main-d'œuvre. - Gérer le budget RH du site et favoriser l'efficacité des processus et l'optimisation des coûts d'exploitation. - Contribuer aux initiatives et projets RH mondiaux, en représentant les perspectives du site. 2. Relations avec les employés, conformité et gouvernance (SITE) - Prendre en charge les relations avec les employés et la conformité au droit du travail, y compris les enquêtes, les griefs et la résolution des litiges. - Diriger l'engagement avec les partenaires sociaux et les représentants des employés, le cas échéant. - Représenter l'entreprise lors des audits internes et externes. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service juridique et le service des communications sur les dossiers sensibles. - S'approprier les thèmes de l'intégrité, de la prise de parole et de l'éthique au niveau du site et du pays. - Veiller à l'application cohérente des politiques, des contrôles internes et des exigences réglementaires. 3. Talent, leadership et engagement (exécution du site) - Diriger la planification stratégique des effectifs en fonction de la capacité du site, de ses aptitudes et de ses besoins futurs. - Superviser le recrutement pour les rôles critiques et l'attraction des talents au niveau du site. - Diriger la gestion des performances, le développement du leadership et la planification des successions (en conformité avec les cadres mondiaux). - S'occuper de la qualité de l'intégration, de l'accent mis sur le développement des employés et des initiatives d'engagement. - Exécuter des activités d'apprentissage et de développement (non GxP) au niveau du site. - Coordonner les missions internationales (exécution sur le site). - Soutenir les communications internes et l'image de marque de l'employeur au niveau du site. 4. Paie et avantages sociaux (gouvernance du site) - Assurer une gestion précise et conforme de la paie et des avantages sociaux (par l'intermédiaire du People Hub, le cas échéant). - Travailler en partenariat avec Total Rewards pour garantir des pratiques de rémunération compétitives et conformes. - Superviser le temps et la présence, l'absentéisme, la qualité des données de base des RH et la gouvernance de l'administration des RH. - Vous êtes responsable de la gestion des données, ce qui permet d'établir des rapports et des analyses fiables sur les ressources humaines. 5. Reporting, Analytics & KPIs - Assurer un reporting RH précis et en temps voulu sur le site. - Favoriser la prise de décision basée sur les données en utilisant les KPI RH définis. - Suivre les tendances liées à la rétention, à l'engagement, à la performance et aux risques liés à la main-d'œuvre. Indicateurs de performance clés : - La livraison de la feuille de route RH du site (qualité, temps, coût) - La conformité avec le droit du travail, les politiques et les contrôles - L'engagement des employés et l'efficacité du leadership - La rétention des rôles critiques - L'efficacité de la gestion de la performance
• Votre profil : Que recherchons-nous ? Formation : - Licence en droit, relations sociales, psychologie, gestion des ressources humaines ou dans un domaine connexe - Master ou diplôme d'études supérieures en ressources humaines de préférence Expérience : - 10+ ans d'expérience en leadership RH dans un environnement multinational (industrie pharmaceutique de préférence) - Expérience prouvée dans la direction des RH au niveau du site - Expérience dans des environnements multi-sites ou matriciels Langues : - Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais Compétences : - Réflexion stratégique avec un sens aigu des affaires - Capacité avérée à influencer et à conduire le changement - Forte expertise en matière de relations sociales - Leadership du changement et compétences en matière de communication - Grande intégrité, sensibilité culturelle et compétences interpersonnelles Vos avantages : Qu'offrons-nous ? - Parking gratuit - Assurance maladie : Jusqu'à 10% de rabais sur les assurances complémentaires auprès de nos partenaires - Plan d'achat d'actions généreux et personnalisable - Allocation pour enfant : Siegfried AG augmente l'allocation cantonale légale de 10% et verse 100 CHF supplémentaires par mois - Possibilités individuelles de formation continue - Chèques Reka : Siegfried AG offre à ses employés un rabais de 20% - Plan de prévoyance d'entreprise attrayant - Cours de fitness sur place et nombreuses manifestations d'entreprise - Accès à la plateforme de prévoyance Swibeco - 5 semaines de vacances et la possibilité de racheter jusqu'à 2 semaines Si l'idée de rejoindre notre groupe vous enthousiasme, nous serions ravis de vous entendre. Posez votre candidature dès aujourd'hui et participez à la construction de quelque chose d'extraordinaire ! Fondée en 1873 à Zofingen, en Suisse, Siegfried s'est développée en un réseau mondial de 13 sites répartis sur trois continents. Avec une équipe de plus de 3 800 professionnels hautement qualifiés, nous portons les innovations de nos clients pharmaceutiques à l'échelle industrielle et fabriquons des médicaments sûrs pour les patients du monde entier. En tant que CDMO entièrement intégré, Siegfried est l'une des rares organisations aujourd'hui à pouvoir assurer le développement et la fabrication d'API et de formes galéniques finies sous un même toit. Cette combinaison unique de savoir-faire et d'expérience fait de nous le partenaire le plus fiable de l'industrie pharmaceutique. Siegfried est une CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) de premier plan dont le siège se trouve à Zofingen, en Suisse. La société exploite des sites de production à Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Argovie) et Schlieren (Zurich).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione "Sperare di crescere", personalmente e professionalmente: presso Siegfried, offriamo sfide affascinanti e numerose opportunità per mettere in evidenza i vostri talenti. Come partner di fiducia e rispettato dell'industria farmaceutica, rispettiamo le norme più elevate in materia di sicurezza, qualità e sostenibilità, mentre coltiviamo una cultura che vi consente di fiorire. Unitevi a un'azienda globale in piena espansione, dove diverse prospettive e esperienze si incontrano in un ambiente collaborativo. Qui, troverete un luogo di lavoro che valorizza tanto il successo collettivo che le vostre contribuzioni individuali—offrendo opportunità a lungo termine per evolversi e avere un impatto. ## Ruolo - Scrivere o modificare ricette in SAP, secondo le indicazioni fornite dal chimico responsabile del processo - Partecipare alla validazione dei documenti di produzione - Generare i dossier di produzione - Creare e gestire gli ordini di produzione in SAP secondo le indicazioni fornite dal chimico responsabile del processo - Stampare i documenti di produzione e le etichette prodotti nel rispetto della conformità documentaria secondo le procedure interne (qualità, HSE, GMP) ## Supporto ai progetti transversali - Partecipare attivamente a progetti interni in relazione alla Supply Chain, alla qualità, all'IT o all'organizzazione - Contribuire all'innovazione continua dei processi amministrativi ## Profilo
• Cerchiamo innanzitutto una persona esperta in funzioni amministrative strutturate, a suo agio in ambienti esigenti e regolamentati. - Diploma di scuola commerciale o titolo ritenuto equivalente - Esperienza confermata in un ruolo amministrativo - Eccellente padronanza degli strumenti informatici (Office; ERP un atout) - Grande senso della rigore, dell'ordine e del dettaglio - Capacità di lavorare in modo autonomo, metodico e affidabile - A suo agio nella collaborazione con diversi settori - Spirito di analisi, anticipazione e senso delle responsabilità ##
• Cosa offriamo - Parcheggio gratuito - Assicurazioni malattia: fino al 10% di sconto sulle assicurazioni complementari presso i nostri partner - Piano di acquisto di azioni generoso e personalizzabile - Assegno per figli: Siegfried AG aumenta l'assegno legale cantonale del 10% e versa inoltre CHF 100 al mese - Opportunità di formazione continua individuali - Buoni Reka: Siegfried AG concede ai propri collaboratori uno sconto del 20% - Cassa di previdenza d'azienda attraente - Corsi di sport in loco e numerosi eventi aziendali - Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggi collaboratori Swibeco - 5 settimane di ferie e possibilità di riscatto fino a 2 settimane ## Contatto Fondata nel 1873 a Zofingue, in Svizzera, Siegfried è diventata un network globale di 13 siti situati su tre continenti. Con un team di oltre 3 800 professionisti altamente qualificati, portiamo le innovazioni dei nostri clienti farmaceutici a livello industriale e fabbrichiamo medicinali sicuri per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Come CDMO interamente integrata, Siegfried è una delle poche organizzazioni in grado oggi di assicurare lo sviluppo e la produzione di principi attivi (API) e di forme galeniche fini sotto lo stesso tetto. Questa combinazione unica di competenze e esperienza la rende il partner più affidabile dell'industria farmaceutica. Siegfried è una società leader nel settore dei CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) con sede a Zofingen, Svizzera. La società gestisce siti di produzione a Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau) e Schlieren (Zurigo).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description "Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer fascinating challenges and numerous opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner in the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality, and sustainability, while cultivating a culture that allows you to thrive. Join a global company in full expansion, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you will find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to evolve and make an impact. ## Role - Write or modify recipes in SAP, according to instructions provided by the process chemist - Participate in the validation of production documents - Generate production dossiers - Create and manage production orders in SAP according to instructions provided by the process chemist - Print production documents and product labels in compliance with document conformity according to internal procedures (quality, HSE, GMP) ## Cross-functional project support - Actively participate in internal projects related to Supply Chain, quality, IT, or organization - Contribute to the continuous improvement of administrative processes ##
• Profile We are looking for an experienced professional in structured administrative functions, comfortable in demanding and regulated environments. - Commercial diploma or equivalent title - Confirmed experience in an administrative role - Excellent proficiency in computer tools (Office; ERP an asset) - High sense of rigor, order, and detail - Ability to work independently, methodically, and reliably - Comfortable collaborating with various departments - Analytical spirit, anticipation, and sense of responsibility ##
• What we offer - Free parking - Health insurance: up to 10% discount on complementary insurance with our partners - Generous and customizable stock purchase plan - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the cantonal allowance by 10% and pays an additional CHF 100 per month - Individual continuing education opportunities - Reka vouchers: Siegfried AG grants its employees a 20% discount - Attractive company pension fund - On-site sports courses and numerous company events - Access to the Swibeco employee benefits platform - 5 weeks of vacation and possibility of buying up to 2 weeks ## Contact Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has become a global network of 13 sites on three continents. With a team of over 3,800 highly qualified professionals, we bring the innovations of our pharmaceutical clients to an industrial level and manufacture safe medicines for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today able to ensure the development and production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished galenic forms under one roof. This unique combination of expertise and experience makes us the most reliable partner in the pharmaceutical industry. Siegfried is a leading Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) headquartered in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates manufacturing sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung "Erwartet, dass Sie wachsen", persönlich und beruflich: Bei Siegfried bieten wir faszinierende Herausforderungen und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, Ihre Talente zu zeigen. Als vertrauenswürdiger und respektierter Partner in der Pharmaindustrie halten wir die höchsten Standards in Sicherheit, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit, während wir eine Kultur entwickeln, die Ihnen ermöglicht, zu gedeihen. Treten Sie einer globalen Firma bei, die sich in voller Expansion befindet, wo sich diverse Perspektiven und Erfahrungen in einem kollaborativen Umfeld treffen. Hier finden Sie einen Arbeitsplatz, der sowohl den kollektiven Erfolg als auch Ihre individuellen Beiträge schätzt—und Ihnen langfristige Möglichkeiten bietet, sich zu entwickeln und einen Einfluss zu haben. ## Rolle - Schreiben oder ändern Sie Rezepte in SAP, entsprechend den Anweisungen des Prozesschemikers - Teilnehmen Sie an der Validierung von Produktionsdokumenten - Erstellen Sie Produktionsdossiers - Erstellen und verwalten Sie Produktionsaufträge in SAP entsprechend den Anweisungen des Prozesschemikers - Drucken Sie Produktionsdokumente und Produktetiketten im Einklang mit der Dokumentenkonformität entsprechend den internen Verfahren (Qualität, HSE, GMP) ## Unterstützung für Querschnittsprojekte - Aktiv am Projektteilnahme an internen Projekten im Zusammenhang mit der Lieferkette, der Qualität, dem IT oder der Organisation - Beiträge zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der administrativen Prozesse ## Profil Wir suchen eine erfahrene Fachkraft in strukturierten administrativen Funktionen, die sich in anspruchsvollen und regulierten Umgebungen wohlfühlt. - Handelsdiplom oder gleichwertiger Titel - Bestätigte Erfahrung in einer administrativen Rolle - Exzellente Kenntnisse in Computerwerkzeugen (Office; ERP ein Vorteil) - Hoher Sinn für Ordnung, Detail und Genauigkeit - Fähigkeit, unabhängig, methodisch und zuverlässig zu arbeiten - Wohlfühlen Sie sich bei der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Abteilungen - Analytischer Geist, Vorstellung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein ##
• Was wir bieten - Kostenlose Parkplätze - Gesundheitsversicherung: bis zu 10% Rabatt auf zusätzliche Versicherungen bei unseren Partnern - Generöser und anpassbarer Aktienkaufplan - Kinderzulage: Siegfried AG erhöht die kantonalen Zulage um 10% und zahlt zusätzlich CHF 100 pro Monat - Individuelle Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung - Reka-Gutscheine: Siegfried AG gewährt seinen Mitarbeitern einen Rabatt von 20% - Attraktive Unternehmenspension - Sportkurse auf dem Gelände und zahlreiche Unternehmensveranstaltungen - Zugang zur Plattform für Mitarbeitervorteile Swibeco - 5 Wochen Urlaub und Möglichkeit, bis zu 2 Wochen zu kaufen ## Kontakt Gegründet 1873 in Zofingen, Schweiz, hat Siegfried sich zu einem globalen Netzwerk von 13 Standorten auf drei Kontinenten entwickelt. Mit einem Team von über 3.800 hochqualifizierten Fachkräften bringen wir die Innovationen unserer pharmazeutischen Kunden auf industriellen Niveau und produzieren sichere Medikamente für Patienten weltweit. Als vollständig integrierte CDMO ist Siegfried eine der wenigen Organisationen, die heute die Entwicklung und Produktion von Wirkstoffen (API) und fertigen Galenikformen unter einem Dach gewährleisten können. Diese einzigartige Kombination von Expertise und Erfahrung macht uns zum vertrauenswürdigsten Partner in der Pharmaindustrie. Siegfried ist ein führendes Unternehmen für Vertragsentwicklung und -herstellung (CDMO) mit Sitz in Zofingen, Schweiz. Die Firma betreibt Produktionsstandorte in Evionnaz (Wallis), Zofingen (Aargau) und Schlieren (Zürich).

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione "Aspettati di crescere", personalmente e professionalmente: presso Siegfried, offriamo sfide stimolanti e numerose opportunità per valorizzare le tue competenze. Come partner di fiducia e rispettato dell'industria farmaceutica, rispettiamo gli standard più elevati in materia di sicurezza, qualità e durabilità, coltivando una cultura che ti permette di fiorire. Unisciti a un'azienda globale in espansione, dove prospettive e esperienze diverse si incontrano in un ambiente collaborativo. Qui troverai un posto di lavoro che valorizza tanto il successo collettivo quanto i tuoi contributi individuali—offrendo opportunità a lungo termine per crescere ed avere un impatto. ## Il tuo ruolo - Come tecnico, esegui le sintesi di intermedi chimici, principi attivi farmaceutici o eccipienti in chimica a flusso su scale che vanno dal grammo al chilogrammo (kilo-lab). - Sei un punto di riferimento basato sulla tua esperienza di diversi anni su diversi tipi di reattori (CSTR, tubulare, a piastre, letto catalitico) e altre tecnologie di work-up continue (mixer-settler, colonna di estrazione, distillazione a strato sottile). - Partecipi alla scelta degli equipaggiamenti per la chimica a flusso, alla loro manutenzione e al loro miglioramento continuo. - Protocolli le procedure relative alle sintesi, ai risultati e alle conclusioni nel diario di laboratorio elettronico in modo rigoroso. - Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con gli altri membri del team di chimica a flusso e con altri dipartimenti dell'azienda: analitici, produzione, ecc. - Eseguirai la tua attività nel rispetto delle regole HSE e qualità (GMP), rispettando le procedure di Siegfried. ## Il tuo profilo - Possiedi una formazione di tecnico di laboratorio in chimica (CFC). - Hai un'esperienza di 5-10 anni in chimica a flusso. - Hai esperienza con l'uso di sistemi di automazione e conoscenza delle tecniche analitiche (HPLC e sonde PAT). - Maestri gli strumenti informatici classici come Word, Excel, Labware e Outlook. - Una conoscenza della produzione di principi attivi sotto GMP è un plus. - Parli fluentemente francese, una buona conoscenza dell'inglese è un plus. ## I tuoi vantaggi - Orari di lavoro flessibili per conciliare vita familiare, tempo libero e professione - Parcheggio gratuito - Assicurazioni sanitarie: fino al 10% di sconto sulle assicurazioni complementari presso i nostri partner - Piano di acquisto di azioni generoso e personalizzabile - Allocazione per bambini: Siegfried AG aumenta l'allocazione legale cantonale del 10% e versa in più CHF 100 al mese - Possibilità di formazione continua individuale - Buoni Reka: Siegfried AG concede ai suoi collaboratori uno sconto del 20% - Cassa di pensioni aziendale attraente - Corsi di sport in sede e numerosi eventi aziendali - Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggi collaboratori Swibeco - 5 settimane di vacanza e possibilità di acquisto fino a 2 settimane ## A proposito di Siegfried Fondata nel 1873 a Zofingue, in Svizzera, Siegfried è diventata una rete globale di 13 siti distribuiti su tre continenti. Con una squadra di oltre 3 800 professionisti altamente qualificati, portiamo le innovazioni dei nostri clienti farmaceutici a scala industriale e produciamo farmaci sicuri per i pazienti del mondo intero. Come CDMO completamente integrata, Siegfried è una delle poche organizzazioni in grado oggi di garantire lo sviluppo e la produzione di principi attivi (API) e forme galeniche finite sotto lo stesso tetto. Questa combinazione unica di competenze ed esperienza ci rende il partner più affidabile dell'industria farmaceutica.

Description "Expect to grow", both personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer exciting challenges and numerous opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner in the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality, and sustainability, while fostering a culture that allows you to thrive. Join a global company in expansion, where diverse perspectives and experiences converge in a collaborative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact. ## Your Role - As a technician, you execute the syntheses of chemical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients, or excipients in continuous flow chemistry on scales ranging from grams to kilograms (kilo-lab). - You are a point of reference based on your several years of experience with various types of reactors (CSTR, tubular, plate, catalytic bed) and other continuous work-up technologies (mixer-settler, extraction column, thin-layer distillation). - You participate in the selection of continuous flow chemistry equipment, their maintenance, and continuous improvement. - You protocol the procedures related to syntheses, results, and conclusions in the electronic laboratory notebook rigorously. - You work closely with other members of the continuous flow chemistry team and with other departments of the company: analytical, production, etc. - You carry out your activity in compliance with HSE and quality (GMP) rules, respecting Siegfried's procedures. ## Your
• Profile - You hold a laboratory technician training in chemistry (CFC). - You have 5-10 years of experience in continuous flow chemistry. - You have experience with the use of automation systems and knowledge of analytical techniques (HPLC and PAT probes). - You master the classic computer tools such as Word, Excel, Labware, and Outlook. - Knowledge of active ingredient manufacturing under GMP is a plus. - Fluent in French, good knowledge of English is a plus. ## Your Benefits - Flexible working hours to reconcile family life, leisure, and profession - Free parking - Health insurance: up to 10% discount on complementary insurance with our partners - Generous and customizable share purchase plan - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the legal cantonal allowance by 10% and additionally pays CHF 100 per month - Individual opportunities for continuing education - Reka vouchers: Siegfried AG grants its employees a 20% discount - Attractive company pension fund - On-site sports courses and numerous company events - Access to the Swibeco employee benefits platform - 5 weeks of vacation and the possibility to buy up to 2 weeks ## About Siegfried Founded in 1873 in Zofingue, Switzerland, Siegfried has become a global network of 13 sites spanning three continents. With a team of over 3,800 highly qualified professionals, we bring our pharmaceutical clients' innovations to industrial scale and manufacture safe medicines for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today capable of ensuring the development and production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of expertise and experience makes us the most reliable partner in the pharmaceutical industry.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione "Aspettarsi di crescere", personalmente e professionalmente: a Siegfried ci aspettiamo sfide interessanti e numerose opportunità per mettere in mostra le vostre doti. Come partner affidabile e rispettato dell'industria farmaceutica, manteniamo standard elevati nei settori della sicurezza, della qualità e della sostenibilità - e promuoviamo una cultura che vi aiuti a essere riusciti. Unitevi a un'azienda in rapida crescita, globale, in cui diverse prospettive e esperienze si incontrano in un ambiente collaborativo. Troverete un posto di lavoro che apprezza sia il successo collettivo che i vostri contributi individuali - e vi offre opportunità a lungo termine per svilupparvi e fare la differenza. ## Mansioni ### Le tue principali responsabilità In questa funzione, guiderai il reparto sottoposto a te in modo completo e sarai responsabile, con il tuo team, della sicurezza, della qualità e della quantità dei prodotti prodotti in tempo, nonché della diretta gestione dei costi. Guiderai il tuo team di 8 persone, compresi un tecnico di manutenzione, un coordinatore di produzione e un assistente di produzione, nonché i capisquadra e sarai responsabile delle relative aree. · Guiderai i reparti assegnati e il personale sottoposto a te e sarai responsabile dell'addestramento e dello sviluppo professionale, nonché delle misure di sviluppo del personale all'interno del tuo ambito di responsabilità. · Sarai responsabile dell'attuazione e dell'adempimento delle normative regolatorie relative alla sicurezza e alla cGMP nel tuo ambito di responsabilità. · Coordinerai tutti gli argomenti di produzione con il tuo team, sarai visibile, definirai lo standard dell'area e sarai responsabile della sua attuazione. · Condurrerai riunioni di routine e di progetto, stabilirai obiettivi e fornirai feedback diretto ai dipendenti coinvolti. · Provvederai e monitorerai l'esecuzione tempestiva delle misure di risoluzione dei problemi e fornirai supporto metodologico e di contenuto. · Sarai responsabile della documentazione dei processi conformi alle normative (regolamenti, controlli di modifica, ecc.) nel tuo ambito di responsabilità. · Oltre alla supervisione dei processi di produzione, sarà il tuo obiettivo continuare a migliorarli in termini di sicurezza, ecologia e redditività. · L'adempimento dei costi di manutenzione e dei costi dei progetti, nonché l'iniziativa di progetti di investimento per nuove installazioni o ristrutturazioni di installazioni esistenti, spetterà alla tua responsabilità. ## Requisiti ### Il tuo profilo · Laurea in chimica organica o tecnologia chimica · Minimo 5 anni di esperienza di leadership nell'ambito di una produzione chimica · Esperienza in materia di sicurezza dei processi e dell'attività lavorativa, ambiente di produzione GMP e controllo di produzione · Conoscenza delle normative e delle prescrizioni amministrative per una produzione sicura, ecocompatibile e conforme · Buone conoscenze di tedesco e conoscenze di inglese buone ### Le tue doti personali · Ti piace lavorare in team e ti piace l'ambiente operativo · Alta autonomia e orientamento al risultato e alla soluzione caratterizzano il tuo modo di lavorare · Mostrerai iniziativa e sarai abituato a prendere la responsabilità e a prendere decisioni · Hai un forte potere di persuasione e puoi comunicare chiaramente e in modo situazionale · Sei resistente e mantieni la calma anche in situazioni difficili e priorizzi le tue attività nel senso dell'azienda ## Cosa offriamo ### I nostri benefici · Orari di lavoro flessibili consentono di conciliare famiglia, tempo libero e lavoro · Con o senza auto, avrete un vantaggio: o parcheggio agevolato o CHF 60.– di contributo mensile per la mobilità / potrete parcheggiare agevolatamente con noi · Assicurazioni sanitarie: sconti fino al 10% sulle assicurazioni supplementari presso i nostri partner · Piano di acquisto di azioni è generoso e personalizzabile · Indennità per figli: Siegfried AG aumenta l'indennità per figli del 10% rispetto all'approccio legale cantonale · Possibilità di formazione individuale d'accordo · Pausa di mezzogiorno retribuita, il benessere dei nostri dipendenti è importante per noi · Reka-Geld: Siegfried AG concede un 20% di sconto · Pensionskassa: la nostra pensione aziendale è attraente e i contributi sono personalizzabili · Ristorante aziendale / caffetteria: pasti a condizioni agevolate · Posizione centrale: vicino alla stazione ferroviaria con una buona connessione al trasporto pubblico · Accesso a benefici e vantaggi esclusivi per i nostri dipendenti ## Contatto Siegfried è una società di sviluppo e produzione di farmaci con sede a Zofingen, Svizzera, fondata nel 1873. È cresciuta in un network globale con 13 sedi in tre continenti. Con un team di oltre 3.800 professionisti altamente qualificati, portiamo le innovazioni dei nostri clienti farmaceutici nella produzione industriale e produciamo medicinali sicuri per pazienti in tutto il mondo. Come CDMO integrato, Siegfried è uno dei pochi aziende che oggi unisce la sviluppo e la produzione di principio attivo (API) e di forme farmaceutiche complete sotto un unico tetto. Questa combinazione unica di conoscenze e esperienze ci rende il partner più affidabile dell'industria farmaceutica.
descriptionByLocale.en: Description "Expect to grow", both personally and professionally: at Siegfried, we expect interesting challenges and numerous opportunities to showcase your skills. As a reliable and respected partner in the pharmaceutical industry, we maintain high standards in the areas of safety, quality, and sustainability - and promote a culture that helps you succeed. Join a rapidly growing, global company where diverse perspectives and experiences meet in a collaborative environment. You will find a workplace that appreciates both collective success and your individual contributions - and offers long-term opportunities for development and making a difference. ## Responsibilities ### Your main tasks In this role, you will guide the department under your supervision in its entirety and be responsible, together with your team, for the safety, quality, and quantity of products produced on time, as well as the direct management of costs. You will guide your team of 8 people, including a maintenance technician, a production coordinator, and a production assistant, as well as the foremen, and be responsible for their respective areas. · You will guide the assigned departments and the personnel under your supervision and be responsible for training and professional development, as well as personnel development measures within your area of responsibility. · You will be responsible for the implementation and compliance with regulatory requirements regarding safety and cGMP within your area of responsibility. · You will coordinate all production topics with your team, be visible, define the area standard, and be responsible for its implementation. · You will conduct routine and project meetings, set goals, and provide direct feedback to the employees involved. · You will ensure and monitor the timely execution of problem-solving measures and provide methodological and content support. · You will be responsible for the documentation of processes in compliance with regulations (regulations, change controls, etc.) within your area of responsibility. · In addition to supervising production processes, your goal will be to continuously improve them in terms of safety, ecology, and profitability. · The fulfillment of maintenance costs and project costs, as well as the initiative for investment projects for new installations or renovations of existing installations, will be your responsibility. ## Requirements ### Your profile · Degree in organic chemistry or chemical technology · Minimum 5 years of leadership experience in the field of chemical production · Experience in process safety and work activity, GMP production environment, and production control · Knowledge of regulations and administrative prescriptions for safe, ecologically compatible, and compliant production · Good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English ### Your personal skills · You enjoy working in a team and like the operational environment · High autonomy and result and solution orientation characterize your way of working · You will show initiative and be accustomed to taking responsibility and making decisions · You have strong persuasive power and can communicate clearly and situationally · You are resilient and maintain calm even in difficult situations and prioritize your activities in the sense of the company ## What we offer ### Our benefits · Flexible working hours allow you to balance family, leisure time, and work · With or without a car, you will have an advantage: either easy parking or a monthly mobility contribution of CHF 60.– / you can easily park with us · Health insurance: discounts of up to 10% on supplementary insurance with our partners · The share purchase plan is generous and customizable · Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the child allowance by 10% compared to the cantonal legal approach · Possibility of individual training on agreement · Paid lunch break, the well-being of our employees is important to us · Reka-Geld: Siegfried AG grants a 20% discount · Pensionskassa: our company pension is attractive and contributions are customizable · Company restaurant / café: meals at favorable conditions · Central location: near the train station with good public transport connections · Access to exclusive benefits and advantages for our employees ## Contact Siegfried is a pharmaceutical development and production company based in Zofingen, Switzerland, founded in 1873. It has grown into a global network with 13 locations on three continents. With a team of over 3,800 highly qualified professionals, we bring our pharmaceutical customers' innovations into industrial production and produce safe medicines for patients worldwide. As an integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few companies today that combines the development and production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and complete pharmaceutical forms under one roof. This unique combination of knowledge and experiences makes us the most reliable partner in the pharmaceutical industry.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description "Attendez-vous à grandir", à la fois personnellement et professionnellement : chez Siegfried, nous attendons des défis intéressants et de nombreuses opportunités pour mettre en valeur vos compétences. En tant que partenaire fiable et respecté de l'industrie pharmaceutique, nous maintenons des normes élevées dans les domaines de la sécurité, de la qualité et de la durabilité - et nous promouvons une culture qui vous aide à réussir. Rejoignez une entreprise en croissance rapide, mondiale, où des perspectives et des expériences diverses se rencontrent dans un environnement collaboratif. Vous trouverez un lieu de travail qui apprécie à la fois le succès collectif et vos contributions individuelles - et vous offre des opportunités à long terme de développement et de faire la différence. ## Responsabilités ### Vos principales tâches Dans ce rôle, vous guiderez le service sous votre supervision dans son ensemble et serez responsable, avec votre équipe, de la sécurité, de la qualité et de la quantité des produits produits à temps, ainsi que de la gestion directe des coûts. Vous guiderez votre équipe de 8 personnes, y compris un technicien de maintenance, un coordinateur de production et un assistant de production, ainsi que les chefs d'équipe, et serez responsable de leurs domaines respectifs. · Vous guiderez les services assignés et le personnel sous votre supervision et serez responsable de la formation et du développement professionnel, ainsi que des mesures de développement du personnel dans votre domaine de responsabilité. · Vous serez responsable de la mise en œuvre et du respect des exigences réglementaires en matière de sécurité et de cGMP dans votre domaine de responsabilité. · Vous coordonnerez tous les sujets de production avec votre équipe, serez visible, définirez la norme de la zone et serez responsable de sa mise en œuvre. · Vous conduirez des réunions de routine et de projet, fixerez des objectifs et fournirez un retour d'information direct aux employés concernés. · Vous veillerez à l'exécution à temps des mesures de résolution de problèmes et fournirez un soutien méthodologique et de contenu. · Vous serez responsable de la documentation des processus conformes aux réglementations (règlements, contrôles de modification, etc.) dans votre domaine de responsabilité. · En plus de la supervision des processus de production, votre objectif sera de les améliorer continuellement en termes de sécurité, d'écologie et de rentabilité. · Le respect des coûts de maintenance et des coûts de projet, ainsi que l'initiative de projets d'investissement pour de nouvelles installations ou des rénovations d'installations existantes, relèvera de votre responsabilité. ## Exigences ### Votre profil · Diplôme en chimie organique ou en technologie chimique · Minimum 5 ans d'expérience de leadership dans le domaine de la production chimique · Expérience en matière de sécurité des processus et d'activité de travail, environnement de production GMP et contrôle de production · Connaissance des réglementations et des prescriptions administratives pour une production sûre, écologiquement compatible et conforme · Bonne connaissance de l'allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais ### Vos compétences personnelles · Vous aimez travailler en équipe et vous appréciez l'environnement opérationnel · Une haute autonomie et une orientation vers les résultats et les solutions caractérisent votre manière de travailler · Vous ferez preuve d'initiative et serez habitué à prendre des responsabilités et à prendre des décisions · Vous avez un fort pouvoir de persuasion et pouvez communiquer clairement et de manière situationnelle · Vous êtes résistant et maintenez votre calme même dans des situations difficiles et priorisez vos activités dans le sens de l'entreprise ## Ce que nous offrons ### Nos avantages · Des horaires de travail flexibles permettent de concilier famille, temps libre et travail · Avec ou sans voiture, vous aurez un avantage : soit un parking facile, soit une contribution mensuelle de CHF 60.– pour la mobilité / vous pouvez facilement garer votre voiture chez nous · Assurance santé : réductions allant jusqu'à 10% sur les assurances complémentaires auprès de nos partenaires · Le plan d'achat d'actions est généreux et personnalisable · Allocation pour enfants : Siegfried AG augmente l'allocation pour enfants de 10% par rapport à l'approche légale cantonale · Possibilité de formation individuelle sur accord · Pause déjeuner payée, le bien-être de nos employés est important pour nous · Reka-Geld : Siegfried AG accorde une réduction de 20% · Pensionskassa : notre pension d'entreprise est attractive et les cotisations sont personnalisables · Restaurant d'entreprise / café : repas à des conditions avantageuses · Situation centrale : près de la gare avec de bonnes connexions aux transports publics · Accès à des avantages et des bénéfices exclusifs pour nos employés ## Contact Siegfried est une société de développement et de production pharmaceutique basée à Zofingen, en Suisse, fondée en 1873. Elle s'est développée en un réseau mondial avec 13 sites sur trois continents. Avec une équipe de plus de 3 800 professionnels hautement qualifiés, nous apportons les innovations de nos clients pharmaceutiques à la production industrielle et produisons des médicaments sûrs pour les patients dans le monde entier. En tant que CDMO intégré, Siegfried est l'une des rares entreprises aujourd'hui qui combine le développement et la production de principes actifs pharmaceutiques (API) et de formes pharmaceutiques complètes sous un même toit. Cette combinaison unique de connaissances et d'expériences nous rend le partenaire le plus fiable de l'industrie pharmaceutique.

Come partner affidabile e rispettato dell'industria farmaceutica, manteniamo alti standard in termini di sicurezza, qualità e sostenibilità, promuovendo contemporaneamente una cultura che vi abilita a essere riusciti. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti compiti stimolanti e un alto grado di varietà. - Responsabilità globale per la coordinazione delle attività analitiche all'interno dei vostri progetti (ad esempio, sviluppo, trasferimento e validazione dei metodi, risoluzione dei problemi) durante tutto il ciclo di vita, dalla valutazione alla produzione commerciale. - Leadership tecnica e responsabilità analitica all'interno dei progetti e delle tecnologie assegnati nel campo delle Small Molecules. - Rappresentazione di Siegfried nei confronti dei clienti in riunioni relative ai progetti, sia in presenza che virtualmente. - Interfaccia centrale tra Analisi, Sviluppo Chimico, Produzione, Controllo della Qualità e altri settori. - Supporto nel trasferimento delle conoscenze dallo sviluppo analitico al controllo della qualità. - Creazione, manutenzione e revisione di documenti analitici (ad esempio, specifiche, descrizioni dei metodi, report di validazione e trasferimento, report di sviluppo e campagne). - Partecipazione attiva agli audit dei clienti in questioni analitiche. - Monitoraggio e controllo del budget dei costi analitici nel quadro del piano di progetto. - Adempimento delle regole cGMP e degli standard di sicurezza nel proprio ambito di responsabilità, per garantire un massimo di sicurezza e qualità. ## Il Tuo Profilo ### Conoscenze Tecniche - Un titolo di studio di Master o PhD in Chimica, Farmacia o una formazione accademica comparabile forma la base giusta per questa attività. - 2 a 3 anni di esperienza professionale nell'analisi farmaceutica. - Conoscenze approfondite nelle tecniche di analisi cromatografiche (ad esempio, HPLC, GC) nel campo delle Small Molecules sono un prerequisito. - Conoscenze nell'applicazione di tecniche di analisi spettroscopiche e umide con Small Molecules sono un vantaggio. - Esperienza nel lavoro in un ambiente regolato da GMP è un vantaggio. ### Forze Personali - Le esperienze di gestione di progetti vi aiutano a strutturare la giornata lavorativa. - Siete orientati al servizio e al cliente e avete piacere nel lavorare in squadra. - Buone conoscenze di tedesco e inglese, sia in scrittura che in parlato. ## I Tuoi Benefici - Orari flessibili consentono di conciliare famiglia, tempo libero e lavoro. - Sia che vi muoviate in auto o meno, ne traete vantaggio: parcheggio scontato o CHF 60.–. - Indennità di mobilità mensile. - Assicurazioni sanitarie: sconti fino al 10% su assicurazioni supplementari presso i nostri partner. - Piano di acquisto di azioni è generoso e personalizzabile. - Indennità per bambini: Siegfried AG aumenta l'indennità per bambini del 10% rispetto all'approccio cantonale. - Cassa di previdenza: la nostra cassa di previdenza è attraente e i contributi sono personalizzabili. - Ristorante aziendale / Cafeteria: alimentazione a condizioni preferenziali. - Posizione centrale: ubicazione vicina alla stazione con ottima connessione ai trasporti pubblici. - Accesso a benefici aziendali esclusivi e sconti per i nostri dipendenti. ## Su di Noi Fondata nel 1873 a Zofingen, Svizzera, Siegfried si è trasformata in una rete globale con 13 sedi su tre continenti. Con un team di oltre 3.800 professionisti altamente qualificati, portiamo le innovazioni dei nostri clienti farmaceutici nella produzione industriale e produciamo farmaci sicuri per pazienti in tutto il mondo. Come CDMO completamente integrato, Siegfried è uno dei pochi aziende oggi che possono unire lo sviluppo e la produzione di principi attivi (API) e forme farmaceutiche finite sotto lo stesso tetto. Questa combinazione unica di competenze e esperienze ci rende il partner di fiducia dell'industria farmaceutica.

Tracking and control of the analytical cost budget within the project plan. - Compliance with cGMP regulations and safety standards within your area of responsibility to ensure maximum safety and quality. ## Your Profile ### Technical Skills - Knowledge of the application of spectroscopic and wet-chemical analysis techniques with Small Molecules is an advantage. - Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment is an advantage. ### Personal Strengths - Experience in project management helps you structure your workday. - You are service- and customer-oriented and enjoy working in a team. - Good German and English language skills in both written and spoken form. ## Your Benefits - Flexible working hours allow for the reconciliation of family, leisure, and work. - Whether you drive or not, you benefit: either discounted parking or CHF 60.–. - Monthly mobility allowance. - Health insurance: discounts of up to 10% on additional insurances with our partners. - The share purchase plan is generous and individually customizable. - Child allowance: Siegfried AG increases the child allowance by 10% compared to the cantonal approach. - Individual further training opportunities upon agreement. - Paid rest breaks, the well-being of our employees is important to us. - Reka-Geld: Siegfried AG grants a 20% discount to employees. - Pension fund: Our company pension fund is attractive and contributions are individually customizable. - Company restaurant / cafeteria: Food at preferential conditions. - Central location: Station nearby with very good public transport connections. - Access to exclusive corporate benefits and discounts for our employees. ## About Us Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network with 13 locations on three continents. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few companies today that can combine the development and manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of expertise and experience makes us the trusted partner of the pharmaceutical industry.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description "Expect to grow" , personnellement et professionnellement: chez Siegfried, vous pouvez vous attendre à des défis stimulants et de nombreuses opportunités de démontrer vos talents. Ici, vous trouverez un lieu de travail qui valorise à la fois le succès collectif et vos contributions individuelles, vous offrant des opportunités à long terme de vous développer et de faire la différence. ## Votre Rôle - Dans nos laboratoires, plus de 90 collègues travaillent sur le développement de nouveaux processus et le contrôle de la conformité aux plus hauts standards de qualité, supportant ainsi notre production efficace et orientée client. Nous offrons à nos employés des tâches stimulantes et un haut degré de variété. - Responsabilité globale pour la coordination des tâches analytiques au sein de vos projets (par exemple, développement, transfert et validation des méthodes, dépannage) tout au long du cycle de vie, de l'évaluation à la production commerciale. - Leadership technique et expertise analytique au sein des projets et des technologies attribués dans le domaine des Small Molecules. - Représentation de Siegfried auprès des clients lors de réunions liées aux projets, à la fois sur place et virtuellement. - Interface centrale entre l'Analytique, le Développement Chimique, la Production, l'Assurance de la Qualité et d'autres départements. - Soutien dans le transfert de connaissances du développement analytique au contrôle de la qualité. - Création, maintenance et révision de documents analytiques (par exemple, spécifications, descriptions de méthodes, rapports de validation et de transfert, rapports de développement et de campagnes). - Participation active aux audits clients concernant les questions analytiques. - Suivi et contrôle du budget des coûts analytiques dans le cadre du plan de projet. - Respect des réglementations cGMP et des normes de sécurité dans votre domaine de responsabilité pour garantir une sécurité et une qualité maximales. ## Votre Profil ### Compétences Techniques - Un diplôme de Master ou de Doctorat en Chimie, Pharmacie ou une formation académique comparable forme la base appropriée pour ce poste. - 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans l'analytique pharmaceutique. - Connaissances approfondies des techniques d'analyse chromatographique (par exemple, HPLC, GC) dans le domaine des Small Molecules sont un impératif. - Connaissances de l'application des techniques d'analyse spectroscopique et chimique humide avec les Small Molecules sont un avantage. - Expérience du travail dans un environnement réglementé par le GMP est un avantage. ### Forces Personnelles - L'expérience en gestion de projet vous aide à structurer votre journée de travail. - Vous êtes orienté service et client et vous aimez travailler en équipe. - Bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à la fois à l'écrit et à l'oral. ## Vos Avantages - Horaires de travail flexibles permettent de concilier famille, loisirs et travail. - Que vous conduisiez ou non, vous en tirez avantage : soit un parking à prix réduit, soit CHF 60.–. - Indemnité de mobilité mensuelle. - Assurance santé : réductions allant jusqu'à 10% sur les assurances complémentaires auprès de nos partenaires. - Le plan d'achat d'actions est généreux et personnalisable. - Allocation pour enfants : Siegfried AG augmente l'allocation pour enfants de 10% par rapport à l'approche cantonale. - Possibilités de formation individuelle sur accord. - Pauses de repos payées, le bien-être de nos employés nous tient à cœur. - descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione "Expect to grow", personalmente e professionalmente: A Siegfried, offriamo sfide emozionanti e ampie opportunità per mettere in mostra le vostre abilità. Come partner affidabile e rispettato dell'industria farmaceutica, manteniamo gli standard più alti in termini di sicurezza, qualità e sostenibilità, mentre promuoviamo una cultura che vi consente di prosperare. Unitevi a una società globale in rapida espansione, dove diverse prospettive e esperienze si incontrano in un ambiente collaborativo. Qui, troverete un luogo di lavoro che valorizza sia il successo collettivo che le vostre contribuzioni individuali—offrendo opportunità a lungo termine per crescere e fare un impatto. ### Il tuo ruolo: Formare il Futuro dello Sviluppo Farmaceutico A Siegfried, stiamo costruendo la prossima generazione di capacità di sviluppo farmaceutico e, come parte di quel team, stiamo cercando un visionario Capo Laboratorio di Caratterizzazione Farmaceutica e Preformulazione per aiutare a guidare la strada. Questa è una rara opportunità per progettare, costruire e scalare nuovi laboratori di caratterizzazione e profilo fisico-chimico all'interno di un ambiente globale CDMO. Avrete un ruolo centrale nella definizione di come sviluppiamo i prodotti farmaceutici in futuro e quali tecnologie utilizzare—dalla fase iniziale dell'innovazione fino al lancio. Se siete appassionati di risoluzione di problemi scientifici, vi sentite a vostro agio nel costruire nuove capacità e volete vedere il vostro expertise avere un impatto diretto sui programmi di sviluppo, questo ruolo è per voi. ### Cosa farai? Come Capo Laboratorio nella nostra organizzazione R&D, farete: • Costruire e guidare nuovi laboratori analitici e di sviluppo fisico-chimico (infrastrutture, strumentazione, strumenti digitali e flussi di lavoro) • Stabilire capacità di caratterizzazione e analisi di stato dell'arte che supportano lo sviluppo di formulazione e processo • Guidare lo sviluppo di metodi di cromatografia liquida (LC) supportati da IT, stabilità-indicanti • Progettare e eseguire: •Studi di solubilità e dissoluzione rilevanti per il biologico •Caratterizzazione fisico-chimica di API e prodotti farmaceutici (DP) •Studi di stabilità accelerata (ASAP) •Guidare attività di stato solido e scienza dei materiali: •Schermata di sale, polimorfi e cocrystal •Caratterizzazione di particelle e materiali in bulk •Implementare approcci moderni, dati-guidati e digitali nello sviluppo analitico •Collaborare strettamente con i team di formulazione, processo e produzione •Costruire e promuovere una cultura di eccellenza scientifica, innovazione e condivisione di conoscenze ### Cosa rende questo ruolo unico? • Costruire da zero: Formare laboratori, tecnologie e modi di lavorare • Alta visibilità: Impatto diretto sulle capacità di sviluppo globale di Siegfried • Profondità scientifica: Lavorare all'interfaccia tra scienza dei materiali, analisi e formulazione • Scopo internazionale: Lavorare in Svizzera e Spagna in un ambiente collaborativo ### Il tuo profilo: Cosa stiamo cercando? • Dottorato di ricerca in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Chimica Analitica, Chimica Fisica o campo correlato • Esperienza provata nello sviluppo farmaceutico o analitico (a livello di originatore o grande CDMO) • Esperto forte in CMC sviluppo, specialmente formulazione e sviluppo di processo • Esperienza diretta con: - Sviluppo di metodi di LC (inclusi metodi stabilità-indicanti) - Caratterizzazione di stato solido e scienza dei materiali - Misurazioni di solubilità (apparente, intrinseca) e dissoluzione rilevante per il biologico • Mindset di costruttore: Vi sentite a vostro agio nel creare nuove capacità piuttosto che mantenere quelle esistenti • Esperienza GMP è un plus ma non richiesta • Potenziale di leadership forte e spirito collaborativo • Fluenza in inglese; abilità di lingua locale aggiuntive sono un plus ### I tuoi benefici: Cosa offriamo? ### Crescita Professionale e Impatto • Opportunità di lasciare il vostro marchio scientifico sui nuovi sviluppi capacità • Piani di sviluppo individuali e opportunità di formazione mirate • Team altamente qualificato, internazionale che valorizza l'innovazione e la collaborazione ### Compensazione e Incentivi Attractive • Salario competitivo con incentivi basati sulle prestazioni • Piano di pensione forte con contributi flessibili • Piano di acquisto di azioni dei dipendenti ### Flessibilità e Benessere • Modello di lavoro ibrido con orari flessibili (fino a 2 giorni remoti) • Programmi di salute e benessere, inclusi benefici di fitness a Zofingen ### Perché unirti a noi? Zofingen offre una qualità di vita eccezionale nel cuore della Svizzera, combinando un ambiente professionale vibrante con l'accesso alla natura e ai principali hub europei. Se scegliete la Svizzera o Barcellona, farete parte di una società che investe nel futuro dello sviluppo farmaceutico—e in voi. ### Pronto a costruire qualcosa di nuovo? Se siete eccitati dall'idea di creare laboratori analitici avanzati, guidare la comprensione fisico-chimica e abilitare lo sviluppo farmaceutico più intelligente, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Candidati oggi e unitevi a costruire qualcosa di straordinario! ### Fondazione Fondata nel 1873 a Zofingen, Svizzera, Siegfried è cresciuta in una rete globale di 13 siti su tre continenti. Con un team di oltre 3.800 professionisti altamente qualificati, portiamo le innovazioni dei nostri clienti farmaceutici a scala industriale e produciamo farmaci sicuri per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Come CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) completamente integrato, Siegfried è una delle poche organizzazioni oggi che possono eseguire lo sviluppo e la produzione di API e forme di dosaggio finite sotto un unico tetto. Questa combinazione unica di conoscenze e esperienza ci rende il partner più affidabile nell'industria farmaceutica.
descriptionByLocale.en: "Expect to grow", personally and professionally: At Siegfried, we offer exciting challenges and ample opportunities to showcase your talents. As a trusted and respected partner to the pharmaceutical industry, we uphold the highest standards in safety, quality and sustainability, while fostering a culture that empowers you to thrive. Join a rapidly expanding global company, where diverse perspectives and experiences come together in a collaborative environment. Here, you'll find a workplace that values both collective success and your individual contributions—offering long-term opportunities to grow and make an impact. Your Role: Shape the Future of Pharmaceutical Development At Siegfried, we are building the next generation of pharmaceutical development capabilities—and as part of that team we’re looking for a visionary Lab Head Pharmaceutical Characterization and Preformulation to help lead the way. This is a rare opportunity to design, build, and scale new characterization and phys-chem. profiling laboratories within a global CDMO environment. You’ll play a central role in defining how we develop drug products in the future and which technologies we use—from early-stage innovation through to launch. If you are passionate about scientific problem-solving, thrive on building new capabilities, and want to see your expertise directly impact development programs, this role is for you. What will you do? As Lab Head in our R&D organization, you will: • Build and lead new analytical and physico-chemical development labs (infrastructure, instrumentation, digital tools, and workflows) • Establish state-of-the-art characterization and analytical capabilities supporting formulation and process development • Drive IT-supported, stability-indicating LC method development • Design and execute: •Biorelevant solubility and dissolution studies •Physico-chemical characterization of APIs and drug products (DP) •Accelerated stability studies (ASAP) • Lead solid-state and material science activities: •Salt, polymorph, and cocrystal screening •Particle and bulk material characterization • Implement modern, data-driven and digital approaches to analytical development • Collaborate closely with formulation, process, and manufacturing teams • Build and foster a culture of scientific excellence, innovation, and knowledge sharing What makes this role unique? • Build from scratch: Shape labs, technologies, and ways of working • High visibility: Direct impact on Siegfried’s global development capabilities • Scientific depth: Work at the interface of material science, analytics, and formulation • International scope: Work across Switzerland and Spain in a collaborative environment Your Profile: What are we looking for? • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, or closely related field • Proven experience in pharmaceutical or analytical development (at originator or large CDMO) • Strong expertise in CMC development , especially formulation and process development • Hands-on experience with: - LC method development (including stability-indicating methods) - Solid-state characterization and material science - Solubility (apparent, intrinsic) measurements and Biorelevant Dissolution • A builder mindset : you thrive in creating new capabilities rather than maintaining existing ones • GMP experience is a plus but not required • Strong leadership potential and collaborative spirit • Fluency in English; additional local language skills are a plus Your Benefits: What do we offer? Professional Growth & Impact • A chance to leave your scientific fingerprint on newly built development capabilities • Individual development plans and targeted training opportunities • A highly skilled, international team that values innovation and collaboration Attractive Compensation & Incentives • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives • Strong pension scheme with flexible contributions • Employee Share Purchase Plan Flexibility & Wellbeing • Hybrid work model with flexible hours (up to 2 days remote) • Health and wellness programs, including fitness benefits in Zofingen Why Join Us? Zofingen offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of Switzerland, combining a vibrant professional environment with access to nature and major European hubs. Whether you choose Switzerland or Barcelona, you’ll be part of a company that is investing in the future of pharmaceutical development—and in you . Ready to build what’s next? If you’re excited by the idea of creating advanced analytical labs, driving physico-chemical understanding, and enabling smarter drug development, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of building something extraordinary! Founded in 1873 in Zofingen, Switzerland, Siegfried has grown into a global network of 13 sites across three continents. With a team of more than 3,800 highly skilled professionals, we take the innovations of our pharmaceutical customers to industrial scale and manufacture safe drugs for patients worldwide. As a fully integrated CDMO, Siegfried is one of the few organizations today that can carry out the development and manufacturing of APIs and finished dosage forms under one roof. This unique combination of know-how and experience makes us the most trusted partner in the pharmaceutical industry. Siegfried is a leading CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) headquartered in Zofingen, Switzerland. The company operates manufacturing sites in Evionnaz (Valais), Zofingen (Aargau), and Schlieren (Zurich).
